name: Micron Technology
fiscalYearEnd: Thursday closest to August 31 (FY2025 ended 2025-08-28; FY2026 ends 2026-09-03 per the Q3 FY2026 10-Q cover data)
description: Micron makes memory and storage chips: DRAM (the working memory in servers, phones and PCs, including high-bandwidth memory stacked for AI accelerators) and NAND flash (the storage in SSDs and phones), plus a small NOR business. It sells to hyperscale cloud companies, data-center and PC/phone makers, and automotive and industrial customers, and also sells Crucial-branded consumer SSDs and memory. Revenue is driven by the price of memory and the number of bits shipped, which swing hard with supply and demand. In the quarter ended 2026-05-28 revenue was about 4.5 times the year-earlier quarter, which the 10-Q attributes mainly to average selling prices (DRAM about +260% and NAND about +310% year on year) and to higher bit shipments.

businessLines.name: Cloud Memory Business Unit (CMBU)
businessLines.how: Hyperscale and AI-server customers buy DRAM (including HBM stacked memory) per bit shipped at negotiated prices; revenue moves with HBM and server-DRAM volume and market pricing.
businessLines.description: Memory for large hyperscale cloud customers and HBM for all data-center customers; also DDR, LPDDR and GDDR.

revenue.note: Source: FY2025 10-K, Revenue by Business Unit

businessLines.revenueNote: Source: FY2025 10-K, Revenue by Business Unit

businessLines.name: Core Data Center Business Unit (CDBU)
businessLines.how: Data-center DRAM modules and NAND SSDs sold per unit or bit to enterprise and OEM customers; revenue follows server build-outs and memory and NAND prices.
businessLines.description: Memory for mid-tier cloud, enterprise and OEM data centers, and storage (data center SSDs and NAND components) for all data centers.

revenue.note: Source: FY2025 10-K, Revenue by Business Unit

businessLines.revenueNote: Source: FY2025 10-K, Revenue by Business Unit

businessLines.name: Mobile and Client Business Unit (MCBU)
businessLines.how: Component DRAM and NAND sold to phone and PC makers plus Crucial consumer products; revenue per bit follows market price (FY2023 unit operating loss of $3,189M, FY2025 profit of $1,981M).
businessLines.description: Memory and storage for phones and PCs, including Crucial-branded SSDs and DRAM sold to consumers.

revenue.note: Source: FY2025 10-K, Revenue by Business Unit

businessLines.revenueNote: Source: FY2025 10-K, Revenue by Business Unit

businessLines.name: Automotive and Embedded Business Unit (AEBU)
businessLines.how: Memory and storage parts sold into cars, factory and consumer devices, typically under longer qualification cycles; FY2025 revenue +3% with pricing pressure on legacy products.
businessLines.description: Memory and storage for automotive, industrial and consumer devices (DRAM, NAND, managed NAND, SSDs, NOR).
